Hello Sarah — I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting.

My free slots next week are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

Which of those suits you? My preference is Monday 10:00-10:30. Once you confirm I'll put it in my calendar and we're set.

Good afternoon — I'm planning next week's CSE455 staff meeting (week of Monday 23 November). Could you confirm the official department schedule for that week, in case anything new has been added or anything moved? I want to avoid clashing with it. — Professor Alvarez

Good afternoon, Professor Alvarez. Here is the official schedule for the week of Monday 23 November; nothing has been cancelled or moved.

- 13:00-14:00 Colloquium (you)

For a staff meeting with the TAs, the free stretches in your own week are Tue 11:00-12:10 and Tue 14:20-16:30, Wed 10:00-13:30, Wed 16:00-17:00, Thu 11:10-13:40, Thu 14:40-15:30, and Mon 10:00-13:00 (note the 13:00 colloquium). Working hours are 09:00-17:00.

Hello Professor Alvarez — happy to set up the staff meeting.

Monday 10:00-10:30 does not work for me (I'm committed then), and neither does Monday 14:00-14:30 (seminar) or Tuesday 11:00-11:30. Of your slots, these are free for me:
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

I suggest **Tue 15:00-15:30** (the earliest of them). I've put it in my calendar — confirm and we're set. If you'd rather take one of the Wednesday slots, say so and I'll switch.

One correction to that list: Monday 14:00-14:30 is no longer good — there's a department seminar 14:10-15:40 that afternoon, so I'd rather not put a staff meeting there.

The rest stand: Mon 10:00-10:30 (my preference), Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Tell me which works for you and I'll book it.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I'll keep the staff meeting inside my free stretches and log it once it's confirmed. — Professor Alvarez
You're welcome, Professor Alvarez. Once the staff meeting is settled, send me the time and I'll enter it in the official schedule.
Confirmed: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is. I've put the CSE455 staff meeting in my calendar and logged it. See you then — and thanks for the quick reply.

Understood — Monday 14:00-14:30 off the list (and yes, I have that 14:10-15:40 seminar too).

**Tue 15:00-15:30 works for me — book that one.** It's already in my calendar.

For the record, of the remaining slots: Mon 10:00-10:30 and Tue 11:00-11:30 are taken on my side (lab/advisor on Monday, seminar on Tuesday), while Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30 are free if Tuesday afternoon ever stops working.
The CSE455 staff meeting is settled: **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30**, with Sarah. Please enter it in the official schedule. Thank you. — Professor Alvarez
Great — Tuesday 15:00-15:30, CSE455 staff meeting. It's on my calendar too. See you then, Professor.
Confirmed — Tuesday 15:00-15:30, in both our calendars. I've told the office to enter it officially. I've noted Wednesday morning/early afternoon as the backup if Tuesday ever stops working.
Noted, thanks — Wednesday morning/early afternoon as backup. All set on my side.

Noted and entered: **CSE455 staff meeting — Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30, with Sarah**. That slot was free in the official schedule and fits inside your free stretch after the 13:30-14:20 thesis committee. Thank you.
